'They've broken their pattern,' Captain Tyler corrected. 'Broad daylight, a crowded movie theatre. This is too much fun for one person.' Uniformed officers moved quickly around them, passing in a blur. As they spoke, reporters surged forward, surrounding the two men with shouted questions. name: Sidney Receives a Threat in the Library Computer Lab
description: Sidney sits at a computer terminal in a crowded library room filled with rows of cubicles. As she works, her screen suddenly begins flashing and emitting a loud beep, freezing her text. Confused, she turns to a young man in the adjacent cubicle and asks if his computer has also malfunctioned. He leans over, examines her screen, and tells her she has an instant message, explaining that all the terminals are linked and she should press ALT + M to see it. She hesitates, saying she isn’t signed on, but follows his instruction. A message appears: "YOU'RE GOING TO DIE TONIGHT." Startled, Sidney cries out and jumps from her seat, scanning the room in fear. She tells her two police guards that the person sending the message is in the room. The guards immediately spring into action, moving through the cubicles, pulling people away from their computers to check their screens. Sidney steps back, watching. Moments later, her computer begins flashing and beeping again. She approaches it slowly and presses ALT + M. Another message appears: "THE POLICE CAN'T SAVE YOU." Her face pales. She takes a deep breath, then begins typing. She types the words "FUCK YOU" and hits send.

description: Sidney steps out of her dorm into the morning sunlight. Before she can take a few steps, fifty reporters swarm around her, shouting questions about murders she knows nothing about. Microphones and cameras are thrust toward her face. She backs away, overwhelmed, her breath quickening as the crowd presses in. Reporters demand to know if she knew the victims, if she feels responsible, if there will be more killings. She tries to push through, searching for an escape. A flashy reporter in sunglasses blocks her path, accusing her of committing the murders. Sidney tenses, fists clenching, but before she can react, a punch from the crowd knocks the reporter down. name: Cici's Struggle to Reach Campus Security
description: Cici stands on the porch steps after a phone call with a friend cuts out. The line crackles with static as she tries to respond, but the connection fails. She steps down toward the sidewalk, calling out to a passing young man wearing headphones, but he doesn’t hear her. She considers going to a sorority house down the block where lights are on and people are moving in and out. Instead, she attempts to call campus security. The phone only emits static. She tries again, then moves back up the porch steps, testing the signal. Still no dial tone. She steps inside the house, tries the phone once more, and this time the call connects, though heavily distorted. She dials 511. A voice from campus security answers but breaks up. She reports she’s calling from the Chi Omega house and that someone is harassing her. The voice fades into static and the line dies. She redials, hears the same broken response, and steps further into the house. The signal clears slightly. She speaks again, saying she’s at the Chi Omega house and that someone is harassing her—but the line is silent. Suddenly, a figure appears behind her. A hand grabs her. She spins around, screaming. It’s Dawnie, another girl from the house. Cici catches her breath, tells her she was scared. Dawnie asks if the phone rang. Before Cici can answer, the phone rings again. Loud rock music blares from the receiver. A drunk girl shouts that they need a ride from Grogs to Acid Rain. Dawnie takes the phone, asks if it’s Tina, and says she’s on her way. She hangs up, turns to Cici, and tells her to take the next call and set the alarm.
